verdict.rationale: Cooley AI is described as firm-owned AI that connects to the firm's knowledge and workflows so lawyers can give clients faster insights. An AI S-1 drafting capability can also be updated 'with a few simple prompts' as transaction terms change. Both appear to be used by lawyers on clients' behalf rather than as a self-serve feature, and the client-facing Cooley GO tools (document generators, quarterly data reports) show no AI-generated insights. Missing for 10: a user-facing in-product AI insights feature, AI analysis of the user's own data within Cooley GO, documentation of how clients access the AI output, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
